entry.title: Market brief — Monday 9 November 2026 close
entry.summary: Indian market brief in plain English: Monday 9 November 2026's verified close — Nifty 50 25,044.65 (+58.25, +0.23%), Sensex 81,106.65 (+107.25, +0.13%) and the rupee at 93.93 per dollar, after both benchmarks recovered from steep intraday losses. Gold and silver are shown as pending: IBJA had not published its 9 November benchmark at refresh time, so no bullion level is carried forward.
